scope: Production Iconbox QML/controller under private Plasma/KWin on the already-open Xephyr :513. Test-owned clients only; normal lsi panel and personal applications were not driven.

runs.case: Native wheel pagination and grouped chooser cycles
Native next/previous arrows plus wheel/group regressions
runs.limitation: The standalone plasmawindowed fixture can take keyboard focus when its arrow button is clicked. The check proves page changes without a task action or activation of a different owned client; it does not prove focus retention in the real panel containment.

runs.case: Native single/double click, group chooser, minimize and restore
runs.details: The task model reported the target active before the double click; the signal carried doubleClickActive=true; the native request was minimize; the second double click restored and focused it.

manual_observation.Q360_revision_1: The user reported Operations works in the production session.
manual_observation.remaining: No complete manual acceptance of all P04 gestures was inferred from the synthetic native clients.

failed_attempts.reason: A fixed delay sampled before the queued wheel event reached KWin; replaced with state polling, then the full wheel run passed.
A race in the test fixture's active-state transition; the instrumented rerun records the active state and passes.
The private D-Bus socket path exceeded the Unix socket length limit before UI interaction; the runner now uses a short private directory under ~/tempia.
